title: Lung Function Monitoring During Hypoxemia Episodes
official: Differentiating Pathophysiological Mechanisms of Hypoxemia Episodes by Continuous Lung Function Monitoring in Preterm Infants
summary: Premature infants commonly have desaturation episodes due to different reasons such as cessation of breathing or loss of lung volume. The purpose of this study is to differentiate the mechanisms of desaturation episodes with continuous lung volume monitoring. As we better understand the mechanisms underlying the desaturation episodes, newer strategies directed at underlying pathophysiology can potentially by evaluated for mitigation of these episodes.

interventions.name: Detecting changes in lung volume with hypoxemia episodes

criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Born at ≤32w GA
* Post menstrual age between 30w to 36w
* 4 or more episodes of HEs in the previous 24h (Defined as SpO2\<90≥5s)

Exclusion Criteria:

* Major congenital malformation
* Receiving invasive mechanical ventilation
* Severe neurological injury
* Hemodynamic instability requiring inotropes in last 72h
